description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Ithvokith Ozweltal)
- Vendor B (Valynso Vagar)
- Vendor C (Mocasans Drapolne)
- Vendor D (Nevokdra Rimir)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

Vendor A (Ithvokith Ozweltal):
  - Vendor A includes free data migration
  - Vendor A has strong references from similar hospitals
  - Vendor A quoted a total cost of 325 thousand per year
Vendor B (Valynso Vagar):
  - Vendor B guarantees 99.9% uptime in its contract
  - Vendor B performs encrypted off-site backups
  - Vendor B offers straightforward contract exit terms
  - Vendor B estimates deployment will take 3 months
  - Vendor B currently serves 5 hospital clients
Vendor C (Mocasans Drapolne):
  - Vendor C has a clear product roadmap
  - Vendor C allows workflow customisation
  - Vendor C refuses to include an uptime guarantee
  - Vendor C reported 5 major outages last year
